item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the South China Sea, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. As the subtropical ridge strengthens gradually, the weather will be very hot over southeastern China in the latter part of this week. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines is expected to move across the Philippines, then enter the South China Sea and may develop slightly in the next couple days. The weather will be unsettled over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea over the weekend. However, the development and movement of the area of low pressure are uncertain.
